author: Corridor Crew
description:
The new season of Fallout is here, introducing one of the most anticipated canon creatures, the deathclaw. While we think the combination of practical and computer-generated effects they used was a great way to achieve their amazing result, we can't help but feel that the way it's being marketed is somewhat disingenuous, especially towards ILM and the extent of the CGI work in the final product.

How do you feel about the use of this marketing narrative?
title: "Mostly" Puppets?
